literature.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 人们一致认为,FLUBV 对 季节性流感 流行有显着贡献,但与 FLUAV 相比,其研究还不够。CD8+ T 细胞识别保守的病毒表位,使其成为未来 疫苗 和治疗的有希望的靶标,但 FLUBV 特异性数据仍然有限。 [10.1042/bst20260075]
大多数急性感染者和健康参与者对 H1-HA 和 H5-HA 具有可检测到的 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞反应(分别为 100% 和 75%),与健康参与者相比,流感患者的 HA 特异性 CD4+ T 细胞反应增加。 [10.1002/cti2.70118]

news.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 世卫组织发起了流感和COVID-19预防和控制全球青年竞赛,邀请参赛者制作视频,强调预防和控制措施的重要性。 [news-029071ffc0234224]
流感、COVID-19 和其他呼吸道病毒的 监测 每周报告。流感活动仍然较低且处于基线水平。COVID-19 活动也仍然较低,处于基线水平。资料来源:英国卫生安全局官方统计数据。 [news-670a583b464d1167]
一名七岁男童确诊严重感染甲型(H3)流感,并发休克及脑病,情况危急,入院儿科重症监护室。 [news-d310c6c32938a8d2]
发表在《自然通讯》上的一项研究调查了季前免疫力、年龄、病毒脱落和社区暴露在塑造流感家庭 传播 动态中的作用。研究发现,尽管儿童具有保护性抗体水平,但仍然更容易感染流感,与成人相比,儿童的病毒脱落时间更长,感染风险更高。 [news-1acebfab880c4dbd]
Arjun Dang 博士和 Dhiren Gupta 博士等医学专家报告称,已确认呼吸道病毒广泛传播,主要是甲型流感 (H3N2)、间质肺病毒、冠状病毒和乙型流感。 [news-ce1906cbb927b9f3]

papers.title: Deciphering influenza B virus-derived peptides and their presentation by HLA class I molecules.
papers.abstract: Despite influenza vaccines being widely available, influenza still causes significant morbidity and mortality annually. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

papers.title_original: Deciphering influenza B virus-derived peptides and their presentation by HLA class I molecules.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on influenza B virus (FLUBV)-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes and their presentation by HLA class I molecules, comparing them with influenza A virus (FLUAV). The central question addresses the limited immunological and molecular insights into FLUBV-specific CD8+ T cell responses, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis summarizing current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at cellular and molecular levels. No systematic search strategy, database, or study count is reported; it relies on existing literature to compare FLUBV with FLUAV.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: There is consensus that FLUBV contributes significantly to seasonal influenza epidemics but has been understudied compared to FLUAV. CD8+ T cells recognize conserved viral epitopes, making them promising targets for future vaccines and therapeutics, yet FLUBV-specific data remain limited.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Key evidence gaps include limited data on FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes, their HLA class I presentation, and immunological mechanisms. This knowledge spans both cellular and molecular levels, highlighting a need for targeted research on FLUBV-specific immune responses.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritize characterizing FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes and their HLA presentation to inform the development of broadly protective vaccines and therapeutics. Addressing these gaps could improve influenza control strategies by leveraging conserved T cell epitopes.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses the limited understanding of influenza B virus (FLUBV)-specific CD8+ T cell responses, which are critical for developing future vaccines and therapeutics. While FLUBV co-circulates with influenza A virus and causes significant morbidity, research on its epitopes and HLA class I presentation is scarce. The review synthesizes current knowledge, highlighting gaps in immunological and molecular insights. Key findings emphasize the potential of conserved CD8+ T cell epitopes for cross-protective immunity, though FLUBV-specific data remain underexplored. Future research should prioritize characterizing FLUBV-derived epitopes to enhance influenza control strategies.

papers.source_body_en: Despite influenza vaccines being widely available, influenza still causes significant morbidity and mortality annually. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

papers.title: Lactylation in influenza a virus infection: Current evidence, knowledge gaps, and future perspectives.
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) is a major respiratory pathogen causing seasonal epidemics and pandemics, posing serious threats to public health and livestock. The high mutation rate of IAV leads to vaccine mismatches and drug-resistant variants, underscoring the need for novel antiviral strategies. This review examines the role of lactylation in IAV-host interactions, focusing on three core questions: how IAV induces lactylation, how lactylation reshapes antiviral immunity, and how IAV exploits lactylation for immune evasion. Key findings include lactylation of viral vRNP components required for efficient replication and the host deacetylase SIRT1, which suppresses IAV replication by removing these lactyl groups. IAV counteracts this defense by downregulating SIRT1 expression. Lactylation also regulates cGAS-STING, RLR-MAVS, and IFN signaling pathways. The therapeutic potential of targeting lactate metabolism and SIRT1 is discussed. Understanding lactylation in IAV infection may open new avenues for antiviral drug development.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review targets seasonal human influenza A and B viruses, specifically A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria lineage, to examine lactylation as a host-virus interaction mechanism during infection. The central question is how lactylation influences influenza A virus (IAV) replication, antiviral immunity, and immune evasion.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis that does not report databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or study selection methods. It synthesizes evidence on lactylation in IAV-host interactions without conducting a systematic or meta-analytic review.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Lactylation of viral vRNP components is required for efficient IAV replication, while host deacetylase SIRT1 suppresses IAV replication by removing lactyl groups. IAV downregulates SIRT1 expression to counteract this antiviral defense. Lactylation also modulates cGAS-STING, RLR-MAVS, and IFN signaling pathways.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not provide quantitative data or mechanistic details on how lactylation of specific viral or host proteins directly alters antiviral pathways. The interplay between lactylation and other post-translational modifications in IAV infection remains unresolved.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Targeting lactate metabolism and SIRT1 activity is proposed as a therapeutic strategy to inhibit IAV replication. Further research is needed to elucidate the precise molecular mechanisms by which lactylation regulates antiviral immunity and immune evasion during IAV infection.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores lactylation as a critical host-virus interaction mechanism in seasonal influenza A and B virus infections. It identifies that lactylation of viral components enhances replication, while host SIRT1-mediated delactylation suppresses infection; however, IAV evades this defense by downregulating SIRT1. Lactylation also modulates key antiviral pathways, including cGAS-STING, RLR-MAVS, and IFN signaling. The review highlights the therapeutic potential of targeting lactate metabolism and SIRT1 but underscores unresolved mechanistic gaps and the need for further research to translate these findings into antiviral strategies.

papers.title: Pre-existing and Cross-Reactive Immunity to Avian Influenza H5N1 in Humans: Implications for Pandemic Risk and Vaccine Strategies.
papers.abstract: Due to the continuous evolution of Influenza A viruses (IAVs), novel strains with efficient human-to-human transmission may emerge and cause future pandemics. Among these, highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 remains a major concern because of its impact on wildlife, livestock, and human health. The widespread circulation of H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b, detected in hundreds of bird species and numerous mammals worldwide, highlights important changes in viral ecology and transmission, increasing its zoonotic and pandemic potential. This review summarizes current evidence on cross-reactive and cross-protective immunity to H5N1 in humans, focusing primarily on humoral immune responses. We examine the presence of pre-existing H5N1-reactive antibodies in individuals without known exposure and discuss how previous seasonal influenza infection or vaccination may contribute to their development. Particular attention is given to antibodies targeting conserved regions of hemagglutinin (HA), especially the stalk domain, as well as neuraminidase (NA), which may provide heterosubtypic protection. We also evaluate the ability of seasonal influenza vaccines and infections to induce cross-reactive responses against H5N1 and their potential role in partial protection or immune priming. Finally, we review current and emerging H5N1 vaccination strategies, including adjuvanted and mRNA-based platforms, and identify priorities for surveillance, population immunity assessment, and the development of broadly protective influenza vaccines.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines pre-existing and cross-reactive immunity to avian influenza H5N1 in humans, focusing on humoral immune responses and their potential to confer partial protection or immune priming against H5N1, a highly pathogenic avian influenza virus with significant zoonotic and pandemic potential.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes evidence on cross-reactive and cross-protective immunity to H5N1 in humans, emphasizing humoral immune responses and conserved regions of hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA), particularly the stalk domain.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights the presence of pre-existing H5N1-reactive antibodies in individuals without known exposure, likely induced by prior seasonal influenza infection or vaccination, and underscores the role of antibodies targeting conserved HA stalk and NA domains in providing heterosubtypic protection.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report the extent of heterogeneity in cross-reactive immune responses across populations, the durability of such immunity, or the precise mechanisms underlying the development of pre-existing H5N1-reactive antibodies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review identifies priorities for surveillance to assess population immunity, the development of broadly protective influenza vaccines, and the evaluation of current and emerging H5N1 vaccination strategies, including adjuvanted and mRNA-based platforms.

analysis.summary_en: This review assesses pre-existing and cross-reactive immunity to avian influenza H5N1 in humans, focusing on humoral responses and conserved viral regions such as the hemagglutinin stalk and neuraminidase. It reports that prior seasonal influenza infection or vaccination may induce H5N1-reactive antibodies in unexposed individuals, potentially offering partial protection or immune priming. The review emphasizes the role of antibodies targeting conserved domains in heterosubtypic protection but does not quantify the durability or heterogeneity of these responses. It calls for enhanced surveillance to evaluate population immunity, the development of broadly protective vaccines, and the assessment of advanced vaccination platforms like adjuvanted and mRNA-based strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 由于甲型流感病毒(IAV)的连续传播,可能会出现具有高效人传人传播的新毒株,并导致未来的大流行。其中,高致病性禽流感(HPAI)H5N1 仍然是一个主要问题,因为它对野生动物、牲畜和人类健康有影响。在全球数百种鸟类和众多哺乳动物中检测到的 H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 的广泛传播,凸显了病毒生态学和 传播 的重要变化,增加了其人畜共患和大流行的可能性。本综述总结了人类对 H5N1 交叉反应和交叉保护性免疫的当前证据,主要关注体液 免疫应答。我们检查了未接触过已知病毒的个体中是否存在预先存在的 H5N1 反应性抗体,并讨论了先前的 季节性流感 感染或 疫苗接种 可能如何促进其发展。特别关注针对血凝素 (HA) 保守区域(尤其是茎结构域)以及神经氨酸酶 (NA) 的抗体,它们可能提供异亚型保护。我们还评估了 季节性流感 疫苗 和感染诱导针对 H5N1 交叉反应的能力及其在部分保护或免疫启动中的潜在作用。最后,我们回顾了当前和新兴的 H5N1 疫苗接种 策略,包括佐剂和基于 mRNA 的平台,并确定了 监测、群体免疫评估和广泛保护性流感 疫苗 的开发的优先事项。

papers.title: Immunogenicity, reactogenicity, and safety of an mRNA-based seasonal influenza and SARS-CoV-2 multicomponent vaccine, mRNA-1083, in adults aged ≥50 years in Japan.
papers.abstract: A multicomponent vaccine targeting seasonal influenza and coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) may reduce disease burden by providing simultaneous protection in a single injection. We report findings from Part 1 (Japan) of a phase 3, Asia-Pacific, randomized, observer-blind study evaluating immunogenicity, reactogenicity, and safety of mRNA-based multicomponent vaccine mRNA-1083, combining influenza and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) antigens. Participants aged ≥50 years were randomized (1:1) to receive mRNA-1083 + placebo or Japan-licensed influenza hemagglutinin (HA) vaccine + mRNA-1273. Overall, 2022 participants were randomized, and 2013 received study intervention. At Day 29, mRNA-1083 elicited noninferior immune responses versus active comparators for all evaluated influenza strains and SARS-CoV-2. Among high-risk participants (aged ≥65 years and 60 to <65 years with ≥1 comorbidity), noninferiority of mRNA-1083 was demonstrated for comparator-matched influenza strains and SARS-CoV-2. In the overall study population, mRNA-1083 demonstrated superiority for the comparator-matched influenza strains and for SARS-CoV-2. At Day 181, immune responses remained above baseline and were comparable to or numerically higher than those elicited by active comparators. Most solicited adverse reactions were grade 1 or 2. There were no cases of myocarditis or pericarditis, and no reported serious adverse events or deaths related to study intervention. Overall, mRNA-1083 demonstrated an acceptable safety profile, eliciting noninferior and superior immune responses against influenza and SARS-CoV-2 in the high-risk and overall study population, respectively. Immune responses were maintained through 6 months post-vaccination. These findings support mRNA-1083 as a single-dose approach to seasonal vaccination against influenza and SARS-CoV-2 in adults ≥50 years. ClinicalTrials.govidentifier: NCT06694389 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06694389).

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 针对 季节性流感 和 COVID-19 的多组分 疫苗 可以通过单次注射同时提供保护来减轻疾病负担。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们报告了一项亚太地区、随机、观察者盲法第 3 阶段研究的第 1 部分(日本)的结果,该研究评估了基于 mRNA 的多组分 疫苗 mRNA-1083(结合流感和 SARS-CoV-2 抗原)的免疫原性、反应原性和安全性。年龄 ≥ 50 岁的参与者被随机 (1:1) 接受 mRNA-1083 + 安慰剂或日本许可的流感血凝素 (HA) 疫苗 + mRNA-1273。总体而言,2022 名参与者被随机分配,2013 年接受了研究干预。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究评估了结合流感和 SARS-CoV-2 抗原的 mRNA-1083 在日本 50 岁以上成年人中的免疫原性、反应原性和安全性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在第 29 天,对于所有评估的流感毒株和 SARS-CoV-2,mRNA-1083 引发的 免疫应答 与活性比较剂相比均不逊色。在高风险参与者中,对照匹配的流感毒株和 SARS-CoV-2 表现出非劣效性。在整个研究人群中,mRNA-1083 表现出对比较匹配的流感毒株和 SARS-CoV-2 的优越性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,mRNA-1083 在高风险和总体研究人群中分别引发了针对流感和 SARS-CoV-2 的非劣效和优越的 免疫应答,且 免疫应答 在 疫苗接种 后 6 个月内保持不变。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持 mRNA-1083 作为针对 ≥50 岁成人的季节性 疫苗接种 流感和 SARS-CoV-2 的单剂量方法,可能通过同时保护来减轻疾病负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项大样本(2013 名参与者)的 3 期随机观察盲试验,由于其稳健的设计以及对免疫原性和安全性的全面评估,结果具有很高的可信度。

papers.title: Molecular Surveillance and Genomic Characterization of Influenza A(H3N2) Viruses From a Secondary-Care Surveillance Site in Pakistan During the 2025-2026 Winter Season.
papers.abstract: Respiratory viral infections, particularly Influenza A and SARS-CoV-2, remain major public health concerns in endemic settings such as Pakistan, where high influenza-like illness burden and limited genomic data underscore the need for surveillance to guide vaccine strategies. This study assessed respiratory virus circulation and genetic diversity among ILI cases at a secondary-care hospital in Islamabad during the 2025-2026 winter season. Among 170 qRT-PCR-tested cases, Influenza A was detected in 24.1%, SARS-CoV-2 in 1.17%, and Influenza B was not detected. Influenza A positivity was slightly higher in females (25.0%), with highest burden in individuals aged 11-20 years. Whole-genome sequencing of 21 Influenza A(H3N2) isolates revealed co-circulation of subclade K (52.4%), J.2.2 (28.6%), and J.2 (9.5%). Phylogenetic analysis showed subclade K clustering with recent isolates from North America, Oceania, Europe, and WHO-recommended 2026-2027 Northern Hemisphere H3N2 vaccine strains, whereas J.2 and J.2.2 aligned with earlier vaccine-like strains. NA analysis showed predominance of clade B.4.2.2 associated with K-lineage and relatedness to recent North American strains. Subclade K exhibited conserved HA substitutions (K2N, S144N, N158D, I160K, Q173R, T328A) and HA2 S49N with limited variation. No antiviral resistance mutations were detected. Overall, findings demonstrate predominance and genetic stability of H3N2 subclade K and support continuous genomic surveillance for vaccine strain selection and influenza preparedness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道病毒感染,特别是甲型流感和 SARS-CoV-2,仍然是巴基斯坦等流行地区的主要公共卫生问题,那里的高流感样疾病负担和有限的基因组数据强调需要 监测 来指导 疫苗 策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了 2025-2026 年冬季伊斯兰堡一家二级护理医院流感样病例中的呼吸道病毒传播和遗传多样性。
elements_zh.methods: 在 170 例 qRT-PCR 检测病例中,甲型流感检出率为 24.1%,SARS-CoV-2 检出率为 1.17%,未检出乙型流感。对 21 种流感 甲型H3N2流感病毒 分离株进行全 基因组 测序,结果显示亚支 K (52.4%)、J.2.2 (28.6%) 和 J.2 (9.5%) 存在共循环。
elements_zh.main_results: 女性甲型流感阳性率略高(25.0%),11-20 岁人群的负担最高。系统发育分析显示,亚进化枝 K 与来自北美、大洋洲、欧洲和 WHO 推荐的 2026-2027 年北半球 H3N2 疫苗 菌株的最新分离株聚类,而 J.2 和 J.2.2 与早期的 疫苗 样菌株一致。NA 分析显示进化枝 B.4.2.2 的优势与 K 谱系相关以及与最近的北美菌株的相关性。亚进化枝 K 表现出保守的 HA 取代(K2N、S144N、N158D、I160K、Q173R、T328A)和变化有限的 HA2 S49N。未检测到 抗病毒药物 抗性 突变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,研究结果证明了 H3N2 亚支 K 的优势和遗传稳定性,并支持连续 基因组监测 用于 疫苗 菌株选择和流感准备。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了 基因组监测 在巴基斯坦追踪流感病毒 进化 和为 疫苗 策略提供信息的重要性,特别是考虑到 K 分支占主导地位,该分支与最近的全球毒株和推荐的 疫苗 成分一致。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在伊斯兰堡的一家二级保健医院进行的,这可能限制了对其他地区或人群的推广。然而,全 基因组 测序和系统发育分析的使用为流行菌株的遗传特征提供了强有力的证据。

papers.title: CD4 + T-cell responses directed towards A/H5N1-derived haemagglutinin peptides increase in patients with seasonal influenza A virus infection.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Recent outbreak of influenza A/H5N1 viral infections in birds and mammals worldwide prompted renewed concerns over an emerging H5N1-related influenza pandemic in the generally immunologically-naive global population. Cross-reactive CD4+ T cells between A/H1N1 and A/H5N1 subtypes targeting internal and surface influenza proteins have been identified in humans, indicating some protection against severe and fatal A/H5N1 infection. METHODS: To detect T-cell responses towards H1 and H5 viruses, we stimulated PBMCs from patients hospitalised with seasonal influenza A viruses, alongside healthy individuals, with overlapping peptide pools spanning hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) of A/Vietnam/1203/2004 (H5N1) and A/New York/18/2009 (H1N1-pdm09-like) viruses. RESULTS: Majority of acutely infected and healthy participants (100% and 75%, respectively) had detectable CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell responses towards H1-HA and H5-HA, whereas 30-80% of individuals had detectable H5-NA responses. H1 and H5 HA-specific CD4+ T-cell responses highly correlated, suggesting some level of cross-reactivity between T-cell responses directed against H1 and H5 subtypes. HA-specific CD4+ T-cell responses were increased in influenza patients compared to healthy participants. We found no differences in H1- and H5-specific T cell responses between those born pre- and post-1968, irrespective of infection status. Sequence alignment of H1 and H5 viruses identified high conservation in the HA2 stalk subunit (81.53%). CD4+ T-cell immunity towards immunodominant HA306-318 epitope, restricted by several HLA-DRB1 molecules, revealed limited cross-reactivity between Group 1 and Group 2 HA-subtypes. CONCLUSION: We define correlative H1- and H5-specific CD4+ T-cell responses during seasonal influenza A virus infection, likely reflecting some level of H1/H5 T cell cross-reactivity.

papers.title: Repeated influenza vaccination results in blunting rather than back-boosting of antibody responses against A(H3N2) antigens
papers.abstract: Abstract Hemagglutination inhibiting (HI) antibody responses against influenza A(H3N2) vaccine strains decline with increasing years of vaccination. It is hypothesized that memory B cell dominance may direct antibody responses towards epitopes conserved with previously-encountered vaccine strains, including non-HI epitopes. To investigate this, we compared healthcare workers with zero versus five consecutive years of vaccination prior to enrolment in 2020 or 2021. We evaluated HI antibody reactivity across 25 A(H3N2) viruses spanning 2007–2022 and antibody binding to recombinant hemagglutinins (HA). HI antibody responses were poor across strains for participants vaccinated five compared to zero of five prior years, independent of pre-vaccination titre. HA and HA-stem binding antibody titre-rises were likewise attenuated in the repeatedly vaccinated group. These results provide no evidence that repeated vaccination promotes antibodies targeting conserved epitopes, rather, repeated vaccination broadly attenuates antibody responses. Work is ongoing to investigate whether attenuation reflects deficient memory B cell differentiation into plasmablasts.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to investigate why hemagglutination inhibiting (HI) antibody responses against influenza A(H3N2) vaccine strains decline with increasing years of vaccination, addressing the knowledge gap of whether repeated vaccination promotes antibodies targeting conserved epitopes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A comparative study was conducted on healthcare workers with zero versus five consecutive years of vaccination prior to enrolment in 2020 or 2021, comparing their antibody responses across 25 A(H3N2) viruses spanning 2007–2022.
analysis.methods: The study evaluated HI antibody reactivity across 25 A(H3N2) viruses and antibody binding to recombinant hemagglutinins (HA), comparing participants with different vaccination histories.
analysis.main_results: HI antibody responses were poor across strains for participants vaccinated five compared to zero of five prior years, independent of pre-vaccination titre, and HA and HA-stem binding antibody titre-rises were likewise attenuated in the repeatedly vaccinated group.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that these results provide no evidence that repeated vaccination promotes antibodies targeting conserved epitopes, rather, repeated vaccination broadly attenuates antibody responses, which is a novel finding challenging the hypothesis of memory B cell dominance directing responses towards conserved epitopes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform that repeated influenza vaccination may not enhance protection against A(H3N2) antigens and could potentially reduce vaccine effectiveness, suggesting a need to reconsider vaccination strategies for influenza A(H3N2).
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to healthcare workers and may not generalize to other populations, but the evidence strength is high due to the direct comparison of well-defined groups and comprehensive analysis across multiple virus strains.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of repeated influenza vaccination on antibody responses against A(H3N2) antigens. Comparing healthcare workers with zero versus five consecutive years of vaccination, the researchers found that repeated vaccination led to blunted rather than enhanced antibody responses. HI antibody responses were poor across 25 A(H3N2) viruses for the repeatedly vaccinated group, independent of pre-vaccination titres, and HA and HA-stem binding antibody rises were similarly attenuated. The results challenge the hypothesis that repeated vaccination promotes antibodies targeting conserved epitopes, suggesting instead that repeated vaccination broadly weakens immune responses. This has significant implications for influenza vaccine strategies, potentially indicating that frequent vaccination may reduce effectiveness against A(H3N2) strains.

papers.title: Affinity-enhanced peptides delivered by mRNA–LNPs inhibit influenza A virus replication by disrupting the PA-PB1 interaction
papers.abstract: Abstract Seasonal influenza causes up to 650,000 deaths annually and remains a persistent pandemic threat due to zoonotic strains crossing the species barrier. Current antivirals, which target neuraminidase or the viral polymerase, have limited efficacy and rapidly select for resistant variants, highlighting the urgent need for new therapeutic strategies. The heterotrimeric influenza polymerase (FluPol), comprising PA, PB1, and PB2 subunits, is essential for viral replication and harbors virus-specific protein-protein interfaces that are potential drug targets. We focused on the highly conserved PA-PB1 interface, where the N-terminal peptide of PB1 binds the PA C-terminal domain with high affinity. Disrupting this interaction abrogates polymerase function, halting viral replication. Using phage display, we identified PB1-derived peptides with enhanced affinity for PA and characterized their binding via biophysical methods and X-ray crystallography. Lead peptides efficiently disrupted the PB1-PA interaction and inhibited polymerase activity in cell-based assays. To address peptide delivery challenges, we expressed these inhibitors intracellularly from synthetic mRNA formulated in lipid nanoparticles, achieving robust inhibition of viral replication in cultured cells. This work establishes intracellularly expressed peptide inhibitors as a viable antiviral strategy and provides a generalizable framework for targeting essential protein-protein interactions of influenza and other RNA viruses.

elements_zh.main_results: 在基于细胞的检测中,先导肽有效地破坏了 PB1-PA 相互作用并抑制聚合酶活性。细胞内表达的肽抑制剂在培养细胞中实现了对病毒复制的强力抑制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 破坏 PA-PB1 相互作用会消除聚合酶功能,从而停止病毒复制。这项工作将细胞内表达的肽抑制剂建立为可行的 抗病毒药物 策略,并为针对流感和其他 RNA 病毒的基本蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用提供了一个通用框架。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果证明了一种通过 mRNA-LNP 传递的亲和力增强肽破坏 PA-PB1 相互作用来抑制甲型流感病毒复制的新方法。这一策略可能会导致新的 抗病毒药物 疗法的开发,并降低耐药性的可能性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在培养细胞中进行的,需要进一步的研究来评估这种方法在动物模型和人类中的有效性和安全性。由于该研究的预印本性质且缺乏体内验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Molecular Characterization of Influenza A(H3N2) Hemagglutinin Variants Circulating in Western Mexico, 2022
papers.abstract: Influenza A(H3N2) remains a significant public health threat due to its rapid antigenic drift, which often compromises vaccine effectiveness. This study characterized the molecular and epidemiological profile of hemagglutinin (HA) variants circulating in Western Mexico throughout 2022. Among 476 positive cases, A(H3N2) was the predominant subtype (88%), with infection peaks during epidemiological weeks (EW) 1, 45, and 46. Sanger sequencing of the HA gene identified 64 amino acid substitutions, with 85.9% of the substitutions located in the HA1 subunit, primarily within the receptor-binding domain (RBD). Homology modeling and molecular docking were performed on five representative variants: C156S, D158N, Y159N, C136S, and L227P. All variants exhibited a slight decrease in binding affinity for sialic acid compared to the 1HGE reference. Notably, while mutations such as D158N and Y159N remodeled the interaction network, Glu190 and His183 remained critical for stabilizing the HA-ligand complex through hydrogen bonds and non-covalent interactions in the structural models. These structural findings suggest that contemporary mutations in the RBD may contribute to changes in receptor-binding interactions while preserving key structural features associated with host cell attachment.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究描述了 2022 年墨西哥西部流行的血凝素 (HA) 变体的分子和流行病学特征。

papers.title_zh: 2022 年墨西哥西部流行的流感 甲型H3N2流感病毒 血凝素变体的分子特征
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A(H3N2) remains a significant public health threat due to its rapid antigenic drift, which often compromises vaccine effectiveness. This study characterized the molecular and epidemiological profile of hemagglutinin (HA) variants circulating in Western Mexico throughout 2022. Among 476 positive cases, A(H3N2) was the predominant subtype (88%), with infection peaks during epidemiological weeks (EW) 1, 45, and 46. Sanger sequencing of the HA gene identified 64 amino acid substitutions, with 85.9% of the substitutions located in the HA1 subunit, primarily within the receptor-binding domain (RBD). Homology modeling and molecular docking were performed on five representative variants: C156S, D158N, Y159N, C136S, and L227P. All variants exhibited a slight decrease in binding affinity for sialic acid compared to the 1HGE reference. Notably, while mutations such as D158N and Y159N remodeled the interaction network, Glu190 and His183 remained critical for stabilizing the HA-ligand complex through hydrogen bonds and non-covalent interactions in the structural models. These structural findings suggest that contemporary mutations in the RBD may contribute to changes in receptor-binding interactions while preserving key structural features associated with host cell attachment.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于 甲型H3N2流感病毒 的快速传播,流感 甲型H3N2流感病毒 仍然是一个重大的公共卫生威胁,这通常会损害 疫苗 的有效性。这项研究描述了 2022 年墨西哥西部流行的血凝素 (HA) 变异的分子和流行病学特征。在 476 例阳性病例中,甲型H3N2流感病毒 是主要亚型 (88%),感染高峰出现在流行病学周 (EW) 的第 1、45 和 46 周。HA 基因的桑格测序发现了 64 个氨基酸替换,其中 85.9% 的替换位于位于 HA1 亚基中,主要位于受体结合域 (RBD) 内。对五个代表性变体进行同源建模和分子对接:C156S、D158N、Y159N、C136S 和 L227P。与 1HGE 参考相比,所有变体对唾液酸的结合亲和力均略有下降。值得注意的是,虽然 D158N 和 Y159N 等 突变 重塑了相互作用网络,但 Glu190 和 His183 对于通过结构模型中的氢键和非共价相互作用稳定 HA-配体复合物仍然至关重要。这些结构发现表明,RBD 中的当代 突变 可能有助于受体结合相互作用的变化,同时保留与 宿主 细胞附着相关的关键结构特征。

papers.title: First detection and transatlantic introduction of Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K (J.2.4.1) into Ecuador: insights from genomic sentinel surveillance
papers.abstract: Background The rapid evolution of Influenza A(H3N2) requires constant global monitoring. This study analyzes the genomic characteristics and the first introduction of the emerging subclade K (J.2.4.1) in Ecuador, utilizing publicly available data to trace its intercontinental movement. Methods The hemagglutinin (HA) protein of an Influenza A(H3N2) strain isolated from an Ecuadorian patient was analyzed. A Bayesian phylogenetic reconstruction was performed using BEAST v1.10.4 with 251 global sequences. A molecular clock was applied to estimate the time of most recent common ancestor (TMRCA). Substitutions were screened using the FluSurver tool. Results Phylogenetic analysis clustered the Ecuadorian isolate within a monophyletic group of European origin (Northern Spain). The estimated introduction occurred in late November 2025, aligning with epidemiological links to Ecuadorian migrants travelling from Spain for Christmas holidays. Molecular screening identified HA1 substitutions annotated in FluSurver as mutations of interest, including S160N, N174D, I176K, Q189R, and Y211F. S160N was associated with the creation of a potential N-glycosylation site. The NA protein harbored the N358D substitution, which was annotated in FluSurver as having a reported association with neuraminidase inhibitor susceptibility. Conclusion The introduction of subclade K into South America illustrates the high efficiency of transatlantic travel as a conduit for viral dispersal. This study supports the use of open-access genomic surveillance as a critical sentinel tool for global health security.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 流感 甲型H3N2流感病毒 的快速 进化 需要持续的全球监测,本研究旨在分析厄瓜多尔新兴亚支 K (J.2.4.1) 的基因组特征和首次引入。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了从厄瓜多尔患者身上分离出的 甲型H3N2流感病毒 流感病毒株的血凝素 (HA) 蛋白,利用公开数据追踪其洲际传播。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 BEAST v1.10.4 和 251 个全局序列进行贝叶斯系统发育重建,应用分子钟来估计最近共同祖先 (TMRCA) 的时间,并使用 FluSurver 工具筛选替换。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析将厄瓜多尔分离株归入欧洲起源(西班牙北部)的单系群中,预计引入发生在 2025 年 11 月下旬,分子筛选鉴定出 HA1 取代,包括 S160N、N174D、I176K、Q189R 和 Y211F,其中 S160N 与潜在 N-糖基化位点的创建相关,NA 蛋白含有 N358D 取代。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: K 分支引入南美说明了跨大西洋旅行作为病毒传播渠道的高效率,这项研究支持使用开放获取的 基因组监测 作为全球卫生安全的关键哨兵工具。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了 基因组监测 对于早期检测新出现的流感毒株的重要性以及国际旅行在病毒传播中的作用,这可以为大流行防范和应对的公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于单一分离株,仅限于基因组分析,没有临床结果,但全局序列和贝叶斯方法的使用为研究结果提供了适度的可信度。

papers.source_body_en: Background The rapid evolution of Influenza A(H3N2) requires constant global monitoring. This study analyzes the genomic characteristics and the first introduction of the emerging subclade K (J.2.4.1) in Ecuador, utilizing publicly available data to trace its intercontinental movement. Methods The hemagglutinin (HA) protein of an Influenza A(H3N2) strain isolated from an Ecuadorian patient was analyzed. A Bayesian phylogenetic reconstruction was performed using BEAST v1.10.4 with 251 global sequences. A molecular clock was applied to estimate the time of most recent common ancestor (TMRCA). Substitutions were screened using the FluSurver tool. Results Phylogenetic analysis clustered the Ecuadorian isolate within a monophyletic group of European origin (Northern Spain). The estimated introduction occurred in late November 2025, aligning with epidemiological links to Ecuadorian migrants travelling from Spain for Christmas holidays. Molecular screening identified HA1 substitutions annotated in FluSurver as mutations of interest, including S160N, N174D, I176K, Q189R, and Y211F. S160N was associated with the creation of a potential N-glycosylation site. The NA protein harbored the N358D substitution, which was annotated in FluSurver as having a reported association with neuraminidase inhibitor susceptibility. Conclusion The introduction of subclade K into South America illustrates the high efficiency of transatlantic travel as a conduit for viral dispersal. This study supports the use of open-access genomic surveillance as a critical sentinel tool for global health security.

papers.title: Assessment of Quantitative Genetic Distances Supports the Separation of H17N10 and H18N11 Subtypes of Influenza A Virus into a Distinct Species
papers.abstract: The taxonomic status of the H17N10 and H18N11 influenza A viruses isolated from bats remains unclear due to the absence of quantitative classification criteria at this taxonomic level. A total of 3328 representative IAV genomes, encompassing all eight protein-coding segments, were analysed. Various genetic distance-based metrics were assessed at the pairwise level, including intra- and intergroup nucleotide distances, dN/dS ratios, and transition/transversion ratios, to facilitate the differentiation of the Alphainfluenzavirus genus into distinct taxa. Pairwise distances for seven of the eight segments (PB2, PB1, PA, NP, M, NA, NS) consistently differentiated the H17–H18 group from H1–H16. Across segments, intergroup nucleotide divergence was consistently above a lower bound of ~25%, with segment-specific values extending to higher levels (up to ~40% in PB2 and PA), while intragroup divergence remained substantially lower. The HA segment did not conform to this pattern, which is consistent with the hypothesis of ancient reassortment. The distribution of pairwise dN/dS values for the PB2, PB1, PA, and NP segments is evidently bimodal. Intergroup comparisons were consistently higher across all segments, whereas intragroup values remained lower. A similar lower boundary of approximately 0.12 was observed across segments, while the upper range of intergroup values varied by gene. Overall, the results support a consistent gene-specific separation pattern. Previously demonstrated absence of reassortment compatibility between bat viruses (H17–H18) and canonical influenza A (H1–H16) viruses indicates that these lineages have evolved independently over an extended period. These consistent genomic patterns provide support for the hypothesis that H17N10 and H18N11 viruses may represent a separate species within the genus Alphainfluenzavirus.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于在分类水平上缺乏定量分类标准,从蝙蝠中分离出的 H17N10 和 H18N11 甲型流感病毒的分类地位仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 总共分析了 3328 个代表性 IAV 基因组,涵盖所有八个蛋白质编码片段。
elements_zh.methods: 在成对水平上评估各种基于遗传距离的指标,包括组内和组间核苷酸距离、dN/dS 比率以及转换/颠换比率,以促进甲型流感病毒属分化为不同的分类群。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 一致的基因组模式为以下假设提供了支持:H17N10 和 H18N11 病毒可能代表甲型流感病毒属内的不同物种,这与 HA 片段古代重配的假设一致。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于流感病毒的分类学分类,并可能为 监测 和蝙蝠流感病毒的进化研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于数据集大和遗传距离模式一致,证据强度很高,尽管该研究因缺乏所有片段的重配兼容性数据而受到限制。

Various genetic distance-based metrics were assessed at the pairwise level, including intra- and intergroup nucleotide distances, dN/dS ratios, and transition/transversion ratios, to facilitate the differentiation of the Alphainfluenzavirus genus into distinct taxa. Pairwise distances for seven of the eight segments (PB2, PB1, PA, NP, M, NA, NS) consistently differentiated the H17–H18 group from H1–H16. Across segments, intergroup nucleotide divergence was consistently above a lower bound of ~25%, with segment-specific values extending to higher levels (up to ~40% in PB2 and PA), while intragroup divergence remained substantially lower. The HA segment did not conform to this pattern, which is consistent with the hypothesis of ancient reassortment. The distribution of pairwise dN/dS values for the PB2, PB1, PA, and NP segments is evidently bimodal. Intergroup comparisons were consistently higher across all segments, whereas intragroup values remained lower. A similar lower boundary of approximately 0.12 was observed across segments, while the upper range of intergroup values varied by gene. Overall, the results support a consistent gene-specific separation pattern. Previously demonstrated absence of reassortment compatibility between bat viruses (H17–H18) and canonical influenza A (H1–H16) viruses indicates that these lineages have evolved independently over an extended period. These consistent genomic patterns provide support for the hypothesis that H17N10 and H18N11 viruses may represent a separate species within the genus Alphainfluenzavirus.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于在分类水平上缺乏定量分类标准,从蝙蝠中分离出的 H17N10 和 H18N11 甲型流感病毒的分类地位仍不清楚。总共分析了 3328 个代表性 IAV 基因组,涵盖所有八个蛋白质编码片段。在成对水平上评估各种基于遗传距离的指标,包括组内和组间核苷酸距离、dN/dS 比率以及转换/颠换比率,以促进甲型流感病毒属分化为不同的分类群。八个片段中的七个(PB2、PB1、PA、NP、M、NA、NS)的成对距离始终将 H17-H18 组与 H1-H16 区分开来。在各个区段中,组间核苷酸分歧始终高于约 25% 的下限,区段特异性值延伸至更高水平(PB2 和 PA 中高达约 40%),而组内分歧仍然大幅较低。HA片段不符合这种模式,这与古代重配的假说是一致的。PB2、PB1、PA 和 NP 段的成对 dN/dS 值分布明显是双峰的。所有细分市场的组间比较始终较高,而组内值仍然较低。在各个片段中观察到大约 0.12 的类似下限,而组间值的上限因基因而异。总体而言,结果支持一致的基因特异性分离模式。先前证明蝙蝠病毒(H17-H18)和典型甲型流感(H1-H16)病毒之间不存在重配兼容性,表明这些谱系在很长一段时间内独立进化。这些一致的基因组模式为 H17N10 和 H18N11 病毒可能代表甲型流感病毒属内的不同物种的假设提供了支持。

papers.full_text: Abstract Antibody responses to seasonal influenza vaccination are shaped by immune history, but the effects of prior vaccination frequency and recency on standard serological endpoints remain incompletely defined. We analyzed paired pre- and post-vaccination hemagglutination inhibition and neuraminidase inhibition titers from 775 adults in the New Zealand SHIVERS-II cohort during the 2018 influenza season and related these to vaccination histories (2013–2017). Post-vaccination titers increased across groups, but participants vaccinated more frequently were less likely to meet conventional ≥4-fold rise and seroconversion criteria, particularly for A/H3N2. Notably, these lower probabilities occurred despite higher absolute post-vaccination titers among frequently vaccinated participants. Longer intervals since the most recent vaccination were associated with higher probabilities of meeting these thresholds; neuraminidase responses showed similar patterns. Pre-vaccination titers were strongly correlated with post-vaccination titers and inversely associated with fold-rise magnitude. These findings indicate that vaccination frequency and recency shape measured humoral responses and highlight that fold-rise-based immunogenicity metrics should be interpreted in the context of baseline immunity and immune history. Despite lower fold rise responses in some groups, most participants showed measurable increases in HAI and NAI titers following vaccination, consistent with ongoing immunologic recall; these serologic findings should not be interpreted as evidence of reduced clinical protection, which was not assessed in this study. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how vaccination history, including frequency and recency, influences humoral responses to seasonal influenza vaccination, as these effects on standard serological endpoints were incompletely defined.
analysis.study_design_and_population: We analyzed paired pre- and post-vaccination hemagglutination inhibition and neuraminidase inhibition titers from 775 adults in the New Zealand SHIVERS-II cohort during the 2018 influenza season, relating these to vaccination histories from 2013–2017.
analysis.methods: Paired pre- and post-vaccination hemagglutination inhibition and neuraminidase inhibition titers were analyzed and related to vaccination histories (2013–2017) to assess immunogenicity metrics.
analysis.main_results: Post-vaccination titers increased across groups, but participants vaccinated more frequently were less likely to meet conventional ≥4-fold rise and seroconversion criteria, particularly for A/H3N2, despite higher absolute post-vaccination titers; longer intervals since the most recent vaccination were associated with higher probabilities of meeting these thresholds.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that vaccination frequency and recency shape measured humoral responses, highlighting that fold-rise-based immunogenicity metrics should be interpreted in the context of baseline immunity and immune history, which was a novel insight for understanding serological responses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform that immunogenicity metrics should be interpreted considering vaccination history, which is crucial for evaluating vaccine efficacy and guiding vaccination strategies, though clinical protection was not assessed.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study did not assess clinical protection, limiting direct public health implications; however, the large sample size and robust serological methods provide moderate evidence strength for the observed immunological patterns.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how vaccination history influences humoral responses to seasonal influenza vaccination in 775 New Zealand adults. Analyzing paired pre- and post-vaccination titers from 2018, researchers found that more frequent vaccination was associated with lower probabilities of meeting conventional seroconversion criteria, despite higher absolute post-vaccination titers, particularly for A/H3N2. Longer intervals since recent vaccination correlated with better serological responses. The findings highlight that fold-rise metrics must be interpreted in the context of baseline immunity and vaccination history, though clinical protection was not assessed. This provides important insights for evaluating vaccine immunogenicity and informing vaccination strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查 疫苗接种 历史(包括频率和新近度)如何影响对 季节性流感 疫苗接种 的体液反应,因为这些对标准血清学终点的影响尚未完全确定。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们分析了 2018 年流感季节期间新西兰 SHIVERS-II 队列研究 中 775 名成年人的配对 疫苗接种 前后血凝抑制和神经氨酸酶抑制滴度,并将这些与 2013-2017 年 疫苗接种 历史相关联。
elements_zh.methods: 对 疫苗接种 前后配对的血凝抑制和神经氨酸酶抑制滴度进行分析,并将其与 疫苗接种 历史(2013-2017)相关联,以评估免疫原性指标。
elements_zh.main_results: 疫苗接种 后的滴度在各组中均有所增加,但尽管 疫苗接种 后的绝对滴度较高,但更频繁地接种疫苗的参与者不太可能满足传统的 ≥4 倍上升和血清转换标准,特别是对于 A/H3N2;自最近的 疫苗接种 以来较长的间隔与满足这些阈值的较高概率相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,疫苗接种 频率和新近形状测量了体液反应,强调基于倍数上升的免疫原性指标应该在基线免疫和免疫史的背景下进行解释,这是理解血清学反应的新见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,应考虑 疫苗接种 历史来解释免疫原性指标,这对于评估 疫苗 疗效和指导 疫苗接种 策略至关重要,尽管尚未评估临床保护。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有评估临床保护,限制了直接的公共卫生影响;然而,大样本量和稳健的血清学方法为观察到的免疫学模式提供了中等的证据强度。

analysis_zh.main_results: 疫苗接种 后的滴度在各组中均有所增加,但尽管 疫苗接种 后的绝对滴度较高,但更频繁地接种疫苗的参与者不太可能满足传统的 ≥4 倍上升和血清转换标准,特别是对于 A/H3N2;自最近的 疫苗接种 以来较长的间隔与满足这些阈值的较高概率相关。

papers.title: Quantum-Classical Reservoir Computing to Predict Influenza A/H3N2 Antigenic Distance
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of antigenic distance between influenza A/H3N2 strains is essential for timely vaccine strain selection, yet traditional hemagglutination inhibition (HI) assays are labour-intensive and limited in throughput. We present FluQRC, a hybrid Quantum-Classical Reservoir Computing framework for sequence-based antigenic distance prediction. FluQRC integrates three novel components: (1) a differentiable gated property ranking network for data-driven property selection, (2) a dimensionality reduction network that compresses the feature representation into a form suitable for quantum processing, and (3) a hybrid quantum-classical reservoir computing architecture for antigenic distance prediction. Experiments on two datasets covering 1963–2002 (271 strains, 73,441 pairs) and 2003–2025 (888 strains, 788,544 pairs) show that FluQRC outperforms four established baselines across all three evaluation metrics (MAE, RMSE, R2). On the larger and more challenging 2003–2025 dataset, FluQRC achieves MAE = 0.369, RMSE = 0.635, and R2 = 0.900, corresponding to a 20.3% reduction in MAE and a 14.3% reduction in RMSE relative to the strongest baseline, while raising R2 from 0.862 to 0.900. These results demonstrate the scalability and effectiveness of FluQRC for large-scale antigenic distance prediction.

On the larger and more challenging 2003–2025 dataset, FluQRC achieves MAE = 0.369, RMSE = 0.635, and R2 = 0.900, corresponding to a 20.3% reduction in MAE and a 14.3% reduction in RMSE relative to the strongest baseline, while raising R2 from 0.862 to 0.900. These results demonstrate the scalability and effectiveness of FluQRC for large-scale antigenic distance prediction.

papers.title: Leveraging perturbations to infer the population dynamics of human rhinovirus and interaction of influenza A virus
papers.abstract: Many respiratory pathogens co-circulate within human populations. Yet, how pathogen community structure shapes the dynamics of infectious diseases remains poorly understood. At the population level, investigating polymicrobial dynamics, with potential underlying competitive or cooperative interactions, is challenging, because of confounding factors such as differing seasonality. This is particularly true for endemic pathogens which typically exhibit stable periodic dynamics. Their disruption due to the implementation of non-pharmaceutical interventions during the COVID-19 pandemic thus represents a unique large-scale natural experiment that can be leveraged to provide valuable insights into the complex interplay between respiratory pathogens. Here, we focus on the population dynamics of human rhinovirus (common cold) and on the potential viral interference of influenza A virus (flu A), which is hypothesized to account for their asynchronous circulation. Using a Bayesian framework, we first show based on simulations that exogenous perturbations can be a powerful tool to disentangle the contribution of pathogen interaction from other epidemiological factors. We then apply our framework to surveillance time series from the US and Canada spanning the COVID-19 pandemic. We estimate key parameters of rhinovirus but find no conclusive support for an influence of influenza A virus at the population level. Author summaryA wide range of respiratory viruses (influenza, coronaviruses, respiratory syncytial virus, . .) circulate in the same communities and can infect the same individuals. Yet, the extent to which these pathogens interact and shape each others spread remains under-explored and represents an emerging frontier in public health. We focus here on the dynamics of human rhinovirus, a leading cause of the common cold, particularly among young children. Rhinovirus and influenza A virus typically peak at different times of the year, raising the possibility of some negative interactions. For viruses that peak at consistent times each year, it is however challenging to determine whether differences in their timing are due to true virus-virus interactions or simply reflect their own, independent, seasonal trends. We develop a mathematical modeling approach that leverages the disruption of these dynamics due to the COVID-19 pandemic as a large-scale natural experiment. Our work demonstrates how such epidemiological perturbations can be used to uncover interactions among co-circulating pathogens. Using multi-year surveillance incidence data from the United States and Canada, we estimate key parameters governing rhinovirus transmission and immunity, but find no substantial impact of influenza A virus.

The findings advance understanding of respiratory pathogen dynamics and inform future surveillance approaches.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解病原体群落结构如何影响传染病动态,重点关注人类鼻病毒和甲型流感病毒的相互作用,利用 COVID-19 大流行的破坏作为自然实验。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用贝叶斯框架应用于美国和加拿大跨越 COVID-19 大流行的 监测 时间序列来分析人口动态。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用贝叶斯框架,首先通过模拟证明外源扰动可以将病原体相互作用与其他流行病学因素分开,然后将这种方法应用于多年的 监测 数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究估计了鼻病毒 传播 和免疫力的关键参数,但没有发现甲型流感病毒在人群水平上产生影响的结论性证据。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,虽然 COVID-19 的干扰提供了对病原体动态的深入了解,但他们的工作证明了这种干扰如何能够揭示共同循环的病原体之间的相互作用,尽管没有发现甲型流感病毒的实质性影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 监测 和呼吸道病原体的建模方法提供了信息,表明虽然大流行的破坏可以揭示病原体的相互作用,但甲型流感病毒可能不会显着影响人群水平的鼻病毒动态。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认,由于季节不同等混杂因素,调查多微生物动力学面临挑战,虽然自然实验设计加强了证据,但仅抽象的性质限制了综合评估。

papers.abstract_zh: 许多呼吸道病原体在人群中共同循环。然而,病原体群落结构如何影响传染病的动态仍然知之甚少。在群体水平上,研究多微生物动态(可能存在潜在的竞争或合作相互作用)具有挑战性,因为存在混杂因素,如不同的季节性。对于通常表现出稳定周期性动态的地方性病原体尤其如此。在COVID-19大流行期间实施非药物干预措施对这些病原体造成的破坏,因此代表了一个独特的大规模自然实验,可以用来提供关于呼吸道病原体之间复杂相互作用的宝贵见解。在这里,我们关注人鼻病毒(普通感冒)的群体动态,以及甲型流感病毒(流感A)的潜在病毒干扰,这种干扰被假定为导致它们异步循环的原因。使用贝叶斯框架,我们首先基于模拟证明,外源性扰动可以是区分病原体相互作用与其他流行病学因素贡献的有力工具。然后我们将该框架应用于美国和加拿大跨越COVID-19大流行的监测时间序列。我们估计了鼻病毒的关键参数,但在群体水平上未发现甲型流感病毒影响的明确证据。作者摘要:多种呼吸道病毒(流感、冠状病毒、呼吸道合胞病毒等)在同一社区循环,并可感染同一个人。然而,这些病原体相互作用并影响彼此传播的程度仍未得到充分探索,代表了公共卫生领域的一个新兴前沿。我们在此关注人鼻病毒的动态,它是普通感冒的主要原因,尤其在幼儿中。鼻病毒和甲型流感病毒通常在一年中的不同时间达到高峰,这引发了某种负面相互作用的可能性。然而,对于每年在固定时间达到高峰的病毒,很难确定它们的时间差异是由于真正的病毒-病毒相互作用,还是仅仅反映了它们各自独立的季节性趋势。我们开发了一种数学建模方法,利用COVID-19大流行期间这些动态的破坏作为大规模自然实验。我们的研究展示了如何利用这类流行病学扰动来揭示共同循环病原体之间的相互作用。使用美国和加拿大多年的监测 传播数据,我们估计了鼻病毒传播和免疫力的关键参数,但未发现甲型流感病毒的重大影响。

papers.title: Estimating the infection fatality ratio of zoonotic avian influenza viruses with pandemic potential using an evolutionary epidemiological model
papers.abstract: The risk of zoonotic avian influenza (AIV) infection to humans is challenging to estimate as many human avian influenza virus infections are undetected because infections may be asymptomatic, symptomatic but not tested, and difficult to identify through contact tracing, as human-to-human transmission is rare. We derive equations that consider the evolutionary mechanisms that give rise to pandemics and are parameterized to be consistent with records of past pandemics. We estimate that thousands of human infections with AIVs possessing pandemic potential occur worldwide in an average year. Combining these estimates with H5N1 fatality data, we estimate a historical average infection fatality ratio of 32 (95% uncertainty interval: 9.6- 75) deaths per 10,000 infections. This estimate is comparable to SARS-CoV-2 during the recent pandemic and higher than seasonal human influenza. We estimate that preventing animal-to- human influenza spillovers would delay pandemic emergence by several years. Preventing human infections with AIVs is necessary given the high risk of severe outcomes to individuals and to reduce the risk of pandemics occurring in the future.

papers.title: Impact of Non-Pharmaceutical Interventions Targeted at COVID-19 Pandemic on Influenza Burden-A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Seasonal influenza imposes a substantial global health burden. The COVID‐19 pandemic, accompanied by widespread non‐pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs), profoundly disrupted respiratory virus circulation, offering a unique opportunity to assess their broader epidemiological impact. This study aimed to quantify changes in influenza burden between the pre‐pandemic and intra‐pandemic periods. Within the RESPINOW project, we conducted a systematic review following PRISMA guidelines. Studies reporting absolute influenza case counts before and during the pandemic were included. Data extraction and quality assessment were performed using a modified NHLBI tool for before–after studies. Influenza cases were normalized by reporting period length, and relative changes were estimated using incidence rate ratios. Subgroup analyses explored age, setting, hemisphere, human development index, influenza transmission zones, WHO regions, and viral strains. Of 20,676 screened records, 115 studies from 98 countries were included. Globally, influenza incidence declined by −92% (95% CI: −94 to −90) following the onset of the pandemic. Reductions varied geographically, ranging from near‐elimination in several countries to more modest declines (e.g., South Korea: −61%, 95% CI: −79 to −26). Decreases were observed across all transmission zones and WHO regions, with descriptively larger reductions observed in high‐income countries (−96%, 95% CI: −98 to −94) than in low‐income settings (−82%, 95% CI: −88 to −73). Age‐specific declines appeared smaller among young children (< 6 years: −66%, 95% CI: −79 to −45) compared with adults aged 18–64 years (−80%, 95% CI: −90 to −63). Influenza A appeared to decline more strongly than influenza B. The COVID‐19 pandemic was associated with an unprecedented global reduction in influenza incidence. Data limitations and the need for robust epidemiological indicators highlight the importance of strengthened, integrated global surveillance to inform future pandemic responses.

source_records.title: Impact of Non-Pharmaceutical Interventions Targeted at COVID-19 Pandemic on Influenza Burden-A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source_records.abstract: Seasonal influenza imposes a substantial global health burden. The COVID-19 pandemic, accompanied by widespread non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs), profoundly disrupted respiratory virus circulation, offering a unique opportunity to assess their broader epidemiological impact. This study aimed to quantify changes in influenza burden between the pre-pandemic and intra-pandemic periods. Within the RESPINOW project, we conducted a systematic review following PRISMA guidelines. Studies reporting absolute influenza case counts before and during the pandemic were included. Data extraction and quality assessment were performed using a modified NHLBI tool for before-after studies. Influenza cases were normalized by reporting period length, and relative changes were estimated using incidence rate ratios. Subgroup analyses explored age, setting, hemisphere, human development index, influenza transmission zones, WHO regions, and viral strains. Of 20,676 screened records, 115 studies from 98 countries were included. Globally, influenza incidence declined by -92% (95% CI: -94 to -90) following the onset of the pandemic. Reductions varied geographically, ranging from near-elimination in several countries to more modest declines (e.g., South Korea: -61%, 95% CI: -79 to -26). Decreases were observed across all transmission zones and WHO regions, with descriptively larger reductions observed in high-income countries (-96%, 95% CI: -98 to -94) than in low-income settings (-82%, 95% CI: -88 to -73). Age-specific declines appeared smaller among young children (< 6 years: -66%, 95% CI: -79 to -45) compared with adults aged 18-64 years (-80%, 95% CI: -90 to -63). Influenza A appeared to decline more strongly than influenza B. The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with an unprecedented global reduction in influenza incidence. Data limitations and the need for robust epidemiological indicators highlight the importance of strengthened, integrated global surveillance to inform future pandemic responses.

analysis.scope_and_question: This systematic review and meta-analysis focused on seasonal influenza viruses (A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), B/Victoria, and historical B/Yamagata) in human populations. The central question was to quantify changes in influenza burden between pre-pandemic and intra-pandemic periods, specifically examining the impact of COVID-19-related non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) on influenza incidence.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study followed PRISMA guidelines and was conducted within the RESPINOW project. It included 115 studies from 98 countries reporting absolute influenza case counts before and during the pandemic. Data extraction and quality assessment used a modified NHLBI tool for before-after studies. Influenza cases were normalized by reporting period length, and relative changes were estimated using incidence rate ratios. Subgroup analyses explored age, setting, hemisphere, human development index, influenza transmission zones, WHO regions, and viral strains.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with an unprecedented global reduction in influenza incidence, with a decline of −92% (95% CI: −94 to −90). Reductions were observed across all transmission zones and WHO regions, with larger decreases in high-income countries (−96%, 95% CI: −98 to −94) compared to low-income settings (−82%, 95% CI: −88 to −73). Age-specific declines were smaller among young children (<6 years: −66%, 95% CI: −79 to −45) than in adults aged 18–64 years (−80%, 95% CI: −90 to −63). Influenza A appeared to decline more strongly than influenza B.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study noted significant geographic variation in influenza reductions, ranging from near-elimination in some countries to more modest declines (e.g., South Korea: −61%, 95% CI: −79 to −26). Data limitations and the need for robust epidemiological indicators were highlighted, particularly regarding the variability in NPI implementation and compliance across settings. The study did not address potential mechanisms behind differential impacts by age or viral type.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings underscore the importance of strengthened, integrated global surveillance to inform future pandemic responses. There is a need for robust epidemiological indicators to better understand the impact of NPIs on respiratory viruses and to develop targeted interventions. Future research should explore the factors contributing to geographic and demographic variations in influenza burden during the pandemic.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis quantified the impact of COVID-19-related non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) on seasonal influenza burden. Analyzing 115 studies from 98 countries, the study found a global reduction in influenza incidence of −92% (95% CI: −94 to −90) during the pandemic. Reductions varied geographically, with larger decreases in high-income countries (−96%) compared to low-income settings (−82%). Age-specific declines were smaller in young children (<6 years: −66%) than in adults (18–64 years: −80%), and influenza A declined more strongly than influenza B. The study highlights the need for strengthened global surveillance to inform future pandemic responses and understand the differential impacts of NPIs.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本系统综述和荟萃分析重点关注人群中的 季节性流感 病毒(甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒、B/Victoria 和历史 B/Yamagata)。核心问题是量化大流行前和大流行期间流感负担的变化,特别检查与 COVID-19 相关的非药物干预措施 (NPI) 对流感 发病率 的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究遵循 PRISMA 指南并在 RESPINOW 项目内进行。它包括来自 98 个国家的 115 项研究,报告了大流行之前和期间的绝对流感病例数。数据提取和质量评估使用修改后的 NHLBI 工具进行前后研究。流感病例通过报告期长度进行标准化,并使用 发病率 比率来估计相对变化。亚组分析探讨了年龄、环境、半球、人类发展指数、流感 传播 区域、世界卫生组织区域和病毒株。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: COVID-19大流行与全球流感发病率史无前例的下降有关,下降了-92%(95% CI:-94至-90)。所有 传播 区域和世卫组织区域均观察到下降,与低收入国家(−82%、95% CI:-88 至 -73)相比,高收入国家(−96%、95% CI:-98 至 -94)下降幅度更大。幼儿(<6岁:-66%,95% CI:-79至-45)的年龄特异性下降幅度小于18-64岁成人(-80%,95% CI:-90至-63)。甲型流感似乎比乙型流感下降得更厉害。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究指出,流感减少情况存在显着的地理差异,从一些国家接近消除到较温和的下降(例如韩国:-61%,95% CI:-79 至 -26)。强调了数据的局限性和对可靠流行病学指标的需求,特别是关于不同环境下 NPI 实施和合规性的可变性。该研究没有解决年龄或病毒类型不同影响背后的潜在机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果强调了加强、一体化的全球 监测 为未来大流行应对措施提供信息的重要性。需要强有力的流行病学指标来更好地了解 NPI 对呼吸道病毒的影响并制定有针对性的干预措施。未来的研究应探讨导致大流行期间流感负担地理和人口变化的因素。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本系统综述和荟萃分析重点关注人群中的 季节性流感 病毒(甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒、B/Victoria 和历史 B/Yamagata)。核心问题是量化大流行前和大流行期间流感负担的变化,特别检查与 COVID-19 相关的非药物干预措施 (NPI) 对流感 发病率 的影响。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究遵循 PRISMA 指南并在 RESPINOW 项目内进行。它包括来自 98 个国家的 115 项研究,报告了大流行之前和期间的绝对流感病例数。数据提取和质量评估使用修改后的 NHLBI 工具进行前后研究。流感病例通过报告期长度进行标准化,并使用 发病率 比率来估计相对变化。亚组分析探讨了年龄、环境、半球、人类发展指数、流感 传播 区域、世界卫生组织区域和病毒株。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: COVID-19大流行与全球流感发病率史无前例的下降有关,下降了-92%(95% CI:-94至-90)。所有 传播 区域和世卫组织区域均观察到下降,与低收入国家(−82%、95% CI:-88 至 -73)相比,高收入国家(−96%、95% CI:-98 至 -94)下降幅度更大。幼儿(<6岁:-66%,95% CI:-79至-45)的年龄特异性下降幅度小于18-64岁成人(-80%,95% CI:-90至-63)。甲型流感似乎比乙型流感下降得更厉害。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究指出,流感减少情况存在显着的地理差异,从一些国家接近消除到较温和的下降(例如韩国:-61%,95% CI:-79 至 -26)。强调了数据的局限性和对可靠流行病学指标的需求,特别是关于不同环境下 NPI 实施和合规性的可变性。该研究没有解决年龄或病毒类型不同影响背后的潜在机制。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果强调了加强、一体化的全球 监测 为未来大流行应对措施提供信息的重要性。需要强有力的流行病学指标来更好地了解 NPI 对呼吸道病毒的影响并制定有针对性的干预措施。未来的研究应探讨导致大流行期间流感负担地理和人口变化的因素。

papers.title: Influenza vaccination associates with reduced risk of incident ischemic stroke among older adults with diabetes: A population-based retrospective cohort study.
papers.abstract: Evidence suggests that a substantial part of influenza-related morbidity and mortality is due to cardiovascular events. Limited population-level evidence exists regarding whether seasonal influenza vaccination is associated with a lower risk of ischemic stroke (IS) in older adults with diabetes. We conducted a retrospective cohort study using data from the Regional Health Information Platform. Among 143,841 diabetic adults aged ≥ 60 y alive and free of prior IS as of January 1, 2022, 131,045 met inclusion criteria and were followed until IS occurrence, death, or July 31, 2022. The primary outcome was first-ever IS. Vaccination exposure was receipt of the 2021/22 seasonal inactivated influenza vaccine. Subdistribution hazard ratios (sHR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) were estimated using Fine-Gray competing risk models, with death as a competing risk. Pneumococcal vaccination served as a negative control. Of 131,045 participants, 54,617 (41.7%) received influenza vaccination. During 75,593 person-years of follow-up over approximately 7 months, 1,427 IS cases occurred (incidence rate: 18.9 per 1,000 person-years). After multivariable adjustment, influenza vaccination was associated with a 15% reduced IS risk within 7 months of follow-up (adjusted sHR = 0.85; 95% CI: 0.76-0.95). This inverse association was consistent across influenza activity phases and was most pronounced during high antigenic similarity epidemic periods (sHR = 0.74; 95% CI: 0.61-0.89) and among patients with coronary heart disease (sHR = 0.46; 95% CI: 0.25-0.86; interaction P = .034). The negative control analysis showed no association between pneumococcal vaccination and IS risk. Seasonal influenza vaccination was associated with a significantly reduced risk of incident IS within 7 months among older adults with diabetes, supporting its potential inclusion as a low-cost stroke prevention strategy in this high-risk population. Randomized controlled trials are warranted to confirm causality.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用区域健康信息平台的数据进行了一项回顾性 队列研究 研究,包括截至 2022 年 1 月 1 日,131,045 名年龄≥ 60 岁且既往无 IS 的糖尿病成人,随访直至 IS 发生、死亡或 2022 年 7 月 31 日。

Among 143,841 diabetic adults aged ≥ 60 y alive and free of prior IS as of January 1, 2022, 131,045 met inclusion criteria and were followed until IS occurrence, death, or July 31, 2022. The primary outcome was first-ever IS. Vaccination exposure was receipt of the 2021/22 seasonal inactivated influenza vaccine. Subdistribution hazard ratios (sHR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) were estimated using Fine-Gray competing risk models, with death as a competing risk. Pneumococcal vaccination served as a negative control. Of 131,045 participants, 54,617 (41.7%) received influenza vaccination. During 75,593 person-years of follow-up over approximately 7 months, 1,427 IS cases occurred (incidence rate: 18.9 per 1,000 person-years). After multivariable adjustment, influenza vaccination was associated with a 15% reduced IS risk within 7 months of follow-up (adjusted sHR = 0.85; 95% CI: 0.76-0.95). This inverse association was consistent across influenza activity phases and was most pronounced during high antigenic similarity epidemic periods (sHR = 0.74; 95% CI: 0.61-0.89) and among patients with coronary heart disease (sHR = 0.46; 95% CI: 0.25-0.86; interaction P = .034). The negative control analysis showed no association between pneumococcal vaccination and IS risk. Seasonal influenza vaccination was associated with a significantly reduced risk of incident IS within 7 months among older adults with diabetes, supporting its potential inclusion as a low-cost stroke prevention strategy in this high-risk population. Randomized controlled trials are warranted to confirm causality.

papers.title: The Role of CD4 T Cell Repertoire and Immune Memory Mechanisms in Vaccination and Infection Immunity.
papers.abstract: CD4 + T cells orchestrate adaptive immunity against respiratory viruses through functionally distinct subsets, yet the qualitative differences between vaccine- and infection-induced responses remain incompletely understood. This review summarizes current evidence on how CD4 + T cell subsets shape the magnitude, breadth, and durability of immunity to SARS-CoV-2 and influenza virus. mRNA vaccines elicit a potent Th1/Tfh1-biased response that generates high-affinity neutralizing antibodies and cytotoxic CD4 + T cells (CD4-CTLs) with stem-cell memory properties. However, this strong type I bias may come at the cost of long-term maintenance of humoral memory. Natural infection additionally establishes tissue-resident memory CD4 + T cells (CD4 TRMs) at respiratory mucosal surfaces, providing a frontline defense that current intramuscular vaccines fail to recapitulate efficiently. Crucially, this T cell immunity proves far more resilient than neutralizing antibodies against Variants of Concern, as many memory T cell epitopes from the ancestral strain are conserved across successive variants, a robustness further reinforced by pre-existing cross-reactive CD4 + T cells primed through prior seasonal coronavirus exposure or influenza infection. These observations argue for a fundamental shift in vaccine design toward mucosal delivery and conserved-epitope antigens to achieve durable, broadly cross-reactive protection.

papers.abstract_zh: CD4 + T 细胞通过功能不同的子集协调针对呼吸道病毒的适应性免疫,但 疫苗 和感染诱导的反应之间的质量差异仍不完全清楚。本综述总结了关于 CD4 + T 细胞亚群如何影响 SARS-CoV-2 和流感病毒免疫的程度、广度和持久性的当前证据。mRNA 疫苗 引发有效的 Th1/Tfh1 偏向反应,产生高亲和力中和抗体和具有干细胞记忆特性的细胞毒性 CD4 + T 细胞 (CD4-CTL)。然而,这种强烈的 I 型偏见可能是以长期维持体液记忆为代价的。自然感染还在呼吸道粘膜表面建立了组织驻留记忆 CD4 + T 细胞 (CD4 TRM),为当前肌肉注射 疫苗 无法有效重演提供前线防御。至关重要的是,这种 T 细胞免疫被证明比针对关注变体的中和抗体更具弹性,因为来自祖先菌株的许多记忆 T 细胞表位在连续变体中是保守的,通过先前的季节性冠状病毒暴露或流感感染引发的预先存在的交叉反应性 CD4 + T 细胞进一步增强了这种稳健性。这些观察结果表明,疫苗 的设计发生了根本性转变,转向粘膜递送和保守表位抗原,以实现持久、广泛的交叉反应保护。

papers.title: Advancing Influenza Prevention: The Case for Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP)
papers.abstract: Influenza remains a significant national health security threat, particularly for vulnerable populations, as existing control measures do not fully mitigate its impact. This gap in protection is especially pronounced early in a pandemic when a well-matched vaccine may not yet be available, as well as in populations unable to mount an optimal vaccine response. Clinical studies support pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) therapeutics as a promising complementary strategy to reduce influenza transmission and disease severity, potentially easing the strain on healthcare systems during outbreaks. This manuscript outlines the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority’s (BARDA’s) target product profile (TPP) for a long-acting influenza PrEP product, reviews the current development landscape, and models the potential impact of early PrEP product deployment using agent-based modeling in a synthetic population of 19.5 million people across pandemic scenarios resembling the 1918, 1968, and 2009 influenza pandemics. Simulations showed that early deployment of a 70%–effective PrEP reduced cumulative and peak infections, delayed the epidemic peak, and provided the greatest benefit in less transmissible pandemics; at 40–50% coverage, PrEP fully mitigated a 2009-like pandemic and substantially reduced transmission in 1918- and 1968-like scenarios. The TPP defines key characteristics of an effective PrEP option for seasonal and pandemic influenza that (1) demonstrates a strong safety and tolerability profile across all populations; (2) targets a direct-acting antiviral mechanism of action; (3) reduces the relative risk of symptomatic influenza infection by at least 70% in an unvaccinated population and (4) provides single-dose, season-long protection to optimize patient adherence. In this context, integrating PrEP into influenza prevention strategies could improve control of virus spread, strengthen protection for high-risk groups, and significantly reduce the overall public health impact of seasonal and pandemic influenza.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) as a complementary strategy for seasonal influenza prevention, addressing gaps in protection for vulnerable populations, especially during early pandemics or in suboptimal vaccine responders. The Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority's (BARDA) target product profile (TPP) outlines key characteristics for an effective PrEP, including 70% efficacy, single-dose season-long protection, and strong safety. Agent-based modeling in 19.5 million people across 1918, 1968, and 2009 pandemic scenarios demonstrated that early PrEP deployment reduced infections, delayed epidemic peaks, and fully mitigated a 2009-like pandemic at 40-50% coverage. The review concludes that integrating PrEP could significantly reduce influenza transmission and public health impact, though challenges remain in vaccine-mismatched scenarios and for high-risk groups.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查重点关注 传播 病毒对国家健康安全的重大威胁,特别是对弱势群体而言,并探讨暴露前预防 (PrEP) 作为补充策略,以在现有控制措施不足时减少 传播 和疾病严重程度。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: The manuscript outlines the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority's (BARDA's) target product profile (TPP) for a long-acting influenza PrEP product, reviews the current development landscape, and models the potential impact of early PrEP deployment using agent-based modeling in a synthetic population of 19.5 million people across pandemic scenarios resembling the 1918, 1968, and 2009 influenza pandemics.
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 临床研究支持 PrEP 疗法作为一种有前途的补充策略,可减少流感 传播 和疾病严重程度。模拟显示,早期部署有效率为 70% 的 PrEP 可减少累积感染和峰值感染,推迟流行高峰,并在传播性较小的流行病中提供最大益处;在 40-50% 的覆盖率下,PrEP 完全缓解了类似 2009 年的大流行,并在类似 1918 年和 1968 年的情况下大幅减少了 传播。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 保护方面的差距在大流行早期尤其明显,此时可能尚未获得良好匹配的 疫苗,以及在无法做出最佳 疫苗 反应的人群中。TPP 定义了有效 PrEP 方案的关键特征,但审查并未解决超出这些限制的潜在争议或具体证据差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 将PrEP纳入流感预防策略可以改善对病毒传播的控制,加强对高危人群的保护,并显着减少季节性和大流行性流感对公众健康的总体影响。TPP 强调强大的安全性、直接作用的 抗病毒药物 机制、症状感染风险至少降低 70%,以及单剂量、全季保护以优化依从性。

papers.title: Influenza Vaccine Effectiveness Against Pediatric Death in the United States: 2016-2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Seasonal influenza vaccination has been shown to reduce the risk of influenza and severe complications among children aged 6 months and older. Since 2010, reported numbers of influenza-associated pediatric deaths among children younger than 18 years have ranged from 37 during the 2011 to 2012 season to 289 during the 2024 to 2025 season. We estimated influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) against pediatric death from 2016 to 2017 through 2024 to 2025. METHODS: We conducted a case-cohort analysis comparing current season influenza vaccination status among reported influenza-associated pediatric deaths with survey estimates of influenza vaccination coverage in pediatric age groups. Underlying medical conditions and current seasonal influenza vaccination were obtained from surveillance case reports. We estimated vaccination odds ratios (OR) and 95% CIs from logistic regression comparing influenza vaccination among children who died with vaccination coverage in comparison cohorts. VE was calculated as (1 - OR) × 100. RESULTS: From August 2016 through July 2025, 1234 laboratory-confirmed influenza-associated pediatric deaths were reported among children aged 6 months to 17 years. Of 1086 reported deaths with influenza vaccination information, 124 (23%) of 530 children with underlying medical conditions and 70 (13%) of 556 children without known conditions were fully vaccinated against influenza. Average influenza vaccination coverage in survey cohorts was 49%. VE was 80% (95% CI 75-84) overall, 77% (95% CI 71-82) among children with underlying medical conditions and 87% (95% CI 84-89) among children without known conditions. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza vaccination reduced risk of fatal influenza among children with or without known underlying medical conditions.

papers.title: Identification of ongoing pregnancies using routine ultrasound procedure codes for timely surveillance of maternal vaccine uptake: A Norwegian registry study.
papers.abstract: AIM: Timely monitoring of maternal vaccination is essential for guiding immunization strategies, but ongoing pregnancies are usually not identified in health registries, resulting in delayed surveillance. We evaluated a registry-based method using routinely collected pregnancy-specific ultrasound procedure codes introduced in 2022 to identify ongoing pregnancies and demonstrate feasibility of timely vaccination surveillance, using influenza vaccination as an example. METHODS: We linked population-based registry data from the Medical Birth Registry of Norway (MBRN), the Norwegian Patient Register (NPR), and the Immunisation Registry. Ongoing pregnancies in the NPR were identified using either second-trimester ultrasound procedure codes (Scenario 1) or a combination of first- and second-trimester codes with adjustments for pregnancy loss and non-attendance (Scenario 2). Estimates of vaccination uptake using ongoing pregnancies identified in the NPR as denominator were compared with estimates using birth data from the MBRN data as denominator (gold standard). Monthly and cumulative seasonal influenza vaccination uptake was assessed from October 2022 to February 2023. RESULTS: A total of 26,996 and 27,940 pregnant women were identified using Scenarios 1 and 2, respectively, compared with 27,513 using MBRN data. Monthly vaccination uptake estimates deviated by less than 1.5% from the gold standard. Cumulative vaccination uptake was 27.1% (7328/26,996) and 26.9% (7503/27,940) for Scenarios 1 and 2, compared with 27.8% (7656/27,513) using MBRN data. CONCLUSIONS: Ongoing pregnancies can be identified through ultrasound procedure codes from administrative healthcare data, enabling robust and timely vaccination surveillance during pregnancy. The approach supports near real-time vaccination monitoring and might be applicable to broader antenatal care surveillance in general.

papers.title: Occupationally Exposed and General Population Antibody Profiles to Influenza A Viruses Circulating in Swine as Indication of Zoonotic Risk.
papers.abstract: Persons with occupational exposure to swine might be at disproportionate risk for zoonotic swine influenza A virus. To evaluate human antibody responses, we tested serum or plasma from swine veterinarian, farm employee, and general population cohorts by hemagglutination inhibition assays against representative swine and human seasonal influenza vaccine strains. We analyzed hemagglutination inhibition data by antigenic cartography to assess strain relationships and reproduction number modeling to evaluate pandemic potential using age-stratified immunity profiles. Occupationally exposed groups had lower human seasonal vaccine uptake (45.5% vs. 70%) and lower odds of seropositivity to several H1 and H3 strains from swine than did general population cohorts. One swine strain exhibited significant antigenic drift (3.62 antigenic units) from its nearest vaccine strain. Multiple strains required lower reproduction number thresholds for pandemic spread (1.09-1.35) than recorded pandemic strains (1.46-1.80), demonstrating that population immunity gaps heighten zoonotic risk to circulating swine H1 and H3 strains.
